# Comparison of literature search versions
# v1 = tiered free-text search
# v2 = unified query with evidence stratification

this qmd is only relevant for PRs. After the PR has been approved, I would suggest deleting this qmd since it's contents are not relevant for the main branch.

```{r setup and label construction}
#| echo: true
#| output: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(readr)

v1 <- read_tsv(here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature_v1.tsv")) # checked out from main
v2 <- read_tsv(here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature.tsv"))

# join key, capitalisation can differ between versions
v1 <- v1 %>% mutate(drug = tolower(drug_name))
v2 <- v2 %>% mutate(drug = tolower(drug_name))

# v1 label: positive if the tiered search stopped at an HDT tier
v1 <- v1 %>%
  mutate(
    v1_positive = search_type == "Direct (HDT)",
    v1_any      = search_type != "No Results"
  )

v2 <- v2 %>%
  mutate(
    n_primary = n_clinical_study + n_human_subject + n_animal + n_in_vitro + n_other,
    n_host    = n_clinical_study + n_human_subject + n_animal + n_in_vitro,
    n_in_vivo = n_clinical_study + n_animal,
    n_human   = n_clinical_study + n_human_subject,  # human hosts only

    HDT_any      = n_hdt > 0,
    HDT_host     = n_hdt > 0 & n_human > 0,          # primary label
    HDT_in_vivo  = n_hdt > 0 & n_in_vivo > 0,
    HDT_clinical = n_hdt > 0 & n_clinical_study > 0,

    L0_any      = unique_articles > 0,
    L1_primary  = n_primary > 0,
    L2_host     = n_host > 0,
    L3_in_vivo  = n_in_vivo > 0,
    L4_clinical = n_clinical_study > 0
  )

cmp <- inner_join(v1, v2, by = "drug", suffix = c("_v1", "_v2"))
```

```{r label counts}
cmp %>%
  summarise(
    `drugs in v1` = nrow(v1), # same set of drugs
    `drugs in v2` = nrow(v2), # same set of drugs
    `only in v1` = length(setdiff(v1$drug, v2$drug)),
    `only in v2` = length(setdiff(v2$drug, v1$drug))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "value") %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r retrieval comparison}
retrieval <- cmp %>%
  summarise(
    `drugs with any result, v1` = sum(v1_any),
    `drugs with any result, v2` = sum(L0_any),
    `total records, v1`         = sum(v1_positive),
    `total records, v2`         = sum(unique_articles),
    `drugs truncated at cap`    = sum(results_truncated)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "value")

print(retrieval, n = Inf)
```

```{r label agreement}
agreement <- cmp %>%
  count(v1_positive, HDT_host) %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(
    v1_positive &  HDT_host ~ "positive in both",
    v1_positive & !HDT_host ~ "lost, positive only in v1",
    !v1_positive & HDT_host ~ "gained, positive only in v2",
    TRUE                    ~ "negative in both"
  ))

print(agreement)

cat("\nv1 positives :", sum(cmp$v1_positive), "\n")
cat("v2 positives :", sum(cmp$HDT_host), "\n")
cat("net change   :", sum(cmp$HDT_host) - sum(cmp$v1_positive), "\n")

# drugs that changed status, name these in the response letter
cat("\nlost (v1 positive, no human host evidence in v2):\n")
print(cmp %>% filter(v1_positive, !HDT_host) %>%
        select(drug, n_hdt, n_review, n_clinical_study:n_other))

cat("\ngained (not positive in v1, HDT plus human host evidence in v2):\n")
print(cmp %>% filter(!v1_positive, HDT_host) %>%
        select(drug, n_hdt, n_clinical_study:n_other) %>%
        arrange(desc(n_hdt)), n = 30)
```

```{r summary for the response letter}
summary_tbl <- tibble(
  statistic = c(
    "drugs evaluated",
    "positives, v1 label (Direct (HDT))",
    "positives, HDT_any",
    "positives, HDT_host",
    "drugs losing the label under HDT_host",
    "drugs gaining the label under HDT_host",
    "records classified, v2",
    "records at other (pathogen-directed), %",
    "records flagged as review, %",
    "records without MeSH indexing, %",
    "drugs truncated at retrieval cap"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(cmp),
    sum(cmp$v1_positive),
    sum(cmp$HDT_any),
    sum(cmp$HDT_host),
    sum(cmp$v1_positive & !cmp$HDT_host),
    sum(!cmp$v1_positive & cmp$HDT_host),
    sum(cmp$unique_articles),
    round(100 * sum(cmp$n_other) / sum(cmp$n_primary), 1),
    round(100 * sum(cmp$n_review) / (sum(cmp$n_primary) + sum(cmp$n_review)), 1),
    round(100 * sum(cmp$n_not_indexed) / sum(cmp$n_primary), 1),
    sum(cmp$results_truncated)
  )
)

print(summary_tbl, n = Inf)
```

```{r candidate literature definitions}
# manually collected evidence for the candidate drugs, matched by title
candidates <- tribble(
  ~drug,               ~evidence,               ~title_pattern,
  "rosuvastatin",      "Cross_2023 [59]",       "Rosuvastatin adjunctive therapy",
  "rosuvastatin",      "Cross_2024 [60]",       "PET-CT outcomes",
  "fostamatinib",      "Mourenza_2020 [61]",    "Novel Treatments against Mycobacterium tuberculosis Based on Drug Repurposing",
  "fluvastatin",       "Montero-Vega_2024 [62]", "Fluvastatin Converts Human Macrophages",
  "tofacitinib",       "Maiga_2015 [63]",       "Efficacy of Adjunctive Tofacitinib",
  "lovastatin",        "Jhilta_2025 [64]",      "Inhalable Lovastatin",
  "atorvastatin",      "Adewole_2023 [65]",     "Atorvastatin accelerates",
  "atorvastatin",      "Davuluri_2023 [66]",    "Atorvastatin Potentially Reduces",
  "tamoxifen",         "Boland_2023 [32]",      "Repurposing Tamoxifen",
  "vemurafenib",       "Mahon_Hafner_2015 [67]", "Immune Cell Regulatory Pathways Unexplored",
  "raloxifene",        "Chugh_2023 [68]",       "Polyphosphate kinase-1 regulates",
  "dasatinib",         "Wehrstedt_2018 [69]",   "tyrosine kinase inhibitor dasatinib reduces",
  "sertraline",        "Shankaran_2023 [70]",   "antidepressant sertraline provides",
  "ethinyl-estradiol", "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "clonidine",         "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "nabumetone",        "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "ketotifen",         "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "naltrexone",        "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "chlorprothixene",   "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "lapatinib",         "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "forskolin",         "No prior evidence",     NA,
  "mometasone",        "No prior evidence",     NA
)

stopifnot(all(candidates$drug %in% v2$drug))

# article-level records, JSON is the only place the cited papers can be looked up
records <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(pmid, title, is_hdt, evidence_level, is_review, drugs)
```

```{r candidate literature retrieval check}
# was each cited paper retrieved, and attached to the right drug?
cited <- candidates %>%
  filter(!is.na(title_pattern)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    hit = list(
      records %>%
        filter(grepl(title_pattern, title, ignore.case = TRUE),
               !grepl("^Erratum|^Correction", title)) %>%  # errata share the original title
        slice_head(n = 1)
    ),
    in_corpus      = nrow(hit) > 0,
    linked_to_drug = in_corpus && drug %in% hit$drugs[[1]],
    pmid           = if (in_corpus) hit$pmid else NA_character_,
    record_is_hdt  = if (in_corpus) hit$is_hdt else NA,
    record_level   = if (in_corpus) hit$evidence_level else NA_character_,
    record_review  = if (in_corpus) hit$is_review else NA
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(drug, evidence, pmid, in_corpus, linked_to_drug,
         record_is_hdt, record_level, record_review)

print(cited, n = Inf)

cat("\ncited papers                  :", nrow(cited), "\n")
cat("in corpus                     :", sum(cited$in_corpus), "\n")
cat("retrieved for the candidate   :", sum(cited$linked_to_drug), "\n")
cat("...and flagged HDT            :", sum(cited$linked_to_drug & cited$record_is_hdt), "\n")

cat("\nnot retrieved for the candidate drug:\n")
print(cited %>% filter(!linked_to_drug) %>% select(drug, evidence, in_corpus))
```

```{r candidate drug level labels}
cand_labels <- candidates %>%
  group_by(drug) %>%
  summarise(prior_evidence = any(!is.na(title_pattern)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    cmp %>% select(drug, v1_positive, unique_articles, n_hdt, n_human,
                   highest_evidence_level, HDT_any, HDT_host, L2_host),
    by = "drug"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(prior_evidence), desc(n_hdt))

print(cand_labels, n = Inf)

cand_labels %>%
  group_by(prior_evidence) %>%
  summarise(
    drugs    = n(),
    v1_pos   = sum(v1_positive),
    HDT_any  = sum(HDT_any),
    HDT_host = sum(HDT_host),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("\nwith prior evidence but not labelled positive under HDT_host:\n")
print(cand_labels %>% filter(prior_evidence, !HDT_host) %>%
        select(drug, v1_positive, unique_articles, n_hdt, n_human))
```

```{r evidence composition of the candidate drugs}
LEVEL_COLS <- names(select(v2, n_clinical_study:n_other))

# candidate order from the manuscript table, by combined mean-rank z-score
CANDIDATE_ORDER <- c(
  "rosuvastatin", "fostamatinib", "fluvastatin", "tofacitinib", "lovastatin",
  "ethinyl-estradiol", "atorvastatin", "clonidine", "nabumetone", "tamoxifen",
  "ketotifen", "vemurafenib", "raloxifene", "naltrexone", "dasatinib",
  "chlorprothixene", "lapatinib", "forskolin", "sertraline", "mometasone"
)
stopifnot(setequal(CANDIDATE_ORDER, candidates$drug))

cmp %>%
  filter(drug %in% candidates$drug) %>%
  select(drug, all_of(LEVEL_COLS)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-drug, names_to = "level", values_to = "records") %>%
  mutate(level = factor(sub("^n_", "", level), levels = rev(sub("^n_", "", LEVEL_COLS)))) %>%
  mutate(drug = factor(drug, levels = rev(CANDIDATE_ORDER))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = records, y = drug, fill = level)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", direction = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "Evidence composition of the candidate drugs",
    x = "records",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "evidence level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r evidence category of the HDT positive records}
# README's "positive records": HDT-restricted query hits, reviews excluded
hdt_positive <- records %>%
  filter(is_hdt, !is_review)

stopifnot(nrow(hdt_positive) == 292)  # matches the README run log

positive_drugs <- cmp %>% filter(HDT_any) %>% pull(drug)
stopifnot(length(positive_drugs) > 0)

LEVEL_ORDER <- c("clinical_study", "human_subject", "animal", "in_vitro", "other")

hdt_positive_counts <- hdt_positive %>%
  count(evidence_level, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    evidence_level = factor(evidence_level, levels = LEVEL_ORDER),
    pct = n / sum(n)
  )

print(hdt_positive_counts %>% arrange(desc(n)))
cat("\nHDT_any positive drugs:", length(positive_drugs), "\n")
cat("HDT positive records   :", nrow(hdt_positive), "\n")

# one-hue sequential ramp, validated colorblind-safe, strongest = darkest
EVIDENCE_RAMP <- setNames(
  c("#104281", "#1c5cab", "#2a78d6", "#5598e7", "#86b6ef"),
  LEVEL_ORDER
)

ggplot(hdt_positive_counts, aes(x = evidence_level, y = n, fill = evidence_level)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, 100 * pct)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = EVIDENCE_RAMP, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Evidence category of the %d HDT positive records (reviews excluded)", nrow(hdt_positive)),
    subtitle = sprintf("the literature behind the %d HDT_any positive drugs",
                       length(positive_drugs)),
    x = NULL,
    y = "records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r strongest HDT-tagged evidence per positive drug}
# each positive drug counted once, by its own strongest HDT-tagged record
# (not its whole bibliography)
drug_hdt_level <- hdt_positive %>%
  filter(lengths(drugs) > 0) %>%
  select(drugs, evidence_level) %>%
  unnest(drugs) %>%
  mutate(drug = tolower(drugs)) %>%
  filter(drug %in% positive_drugs) %>%
  mutate(level_rank = match(evidence_level, LEVEL_ORDER)) %>%
  group_by(drug) %>%
  summarise(strongest = LEVEL_ORDER[min(level_rank)], .groups = "drop")

# n_hdt counts reviews too, so a drug can be positive on an HDT-tagged
# review alone, with no primary HDT-tagged record
missing_drugs <- setdiff(positive_drugs, drug_hdt_level$drug)
if (length(missing_drugs) > 0) {
  cat(length(missing_drugs), "positive drugs have only an HDT-tagged review, no primary HDT record:\n")
  print(missing_drugs)
}

drug_evidence_counts <- tibble(strongest = c(LEVEL_ORDER, "HDT review only")) %>%
  left_join(count(drug_hdt_level, strongest, name = "n"), by = "strongest") %>%
  mutate(
    n = ifelse(strongest == "HDT review only", length(missing_drugs), coalesce(n, 0L)),
    strongest = factor(strongest, levels = c(LEVEL_ORDER, "HDT review only")),
    pct = n / length(positive_drugs)
  )

print(drug_evidence_counts %>% arrange(desc(n)))
cat("\nHDT_any positive drugs:", length(positive_drugs), "\n")
cat("drugs classified       :", sum(drug_evidence_counts$n), "\n")

# review-only sliver gets a neutral gray, it isn't an evidence level
DRUG_EVIDENCE_RAMP <- c(EVIDENCE_RAMP, "HDT review only" = "#999999")

ggplot(drug_evidence_counts, aes(x = strongest, y = n, fill = strongest)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, 100 * pct)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DRUG_EVIDENCE_RAMP, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Strongest HDT-tagged evidence per positive drug (n = %d drugs)",
                    length(positive_drugs)),
    subtitle = "each HDT_any positive drug counted once, by its strongest own HDT-tagged record",
    x = NULL,
    y = "drugs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```
